summary.headline: Astrology as a Busy Matter
summary.text: Editorial introduction to a fragment from a 12th-century Modena manuscript, discussing whether its author was Niketas of Paphlagonia or Peter, patriarch of Antioch, followed by a treatise defining astrology as the calculation of solar, planetary, horoscopic, stellar, zodiacal, and aspectual conditions.
